historical_latin_body: Plenum, quæsumus Dómine, in nobis remédium tuæ miseratiónis operáre: ac tales nos esse pérfice propítius, et sic fovéri; ut tibi in ómnibus placére valeámus.
study_english_body: Work in us, we pray, O Lord, the full remedy of your mercy, and graciously form and sustain us so that we may please you in all things.
study_english_label: New project study translation from public-domain Latin; not approved liturgical English.
conclusion_disposition: Body only. Do not expand old Per Dominum nostrum or modern secondary Per Christum from memory. Integrator must bind separately verified lawful formula and explicitly represent the change of cue.
